costs.annual_energy_equation: hours_at_this_service * (mainline_launch_mechanical_kWh_per_hour / launch_efficiency - recovered_mechanical_kWh_per_hour * receiving_efficiency + hotel_coefficient * measured_hotel_kW_per_car + unclosed_terminal_and_other_electrical_energy)
costs.capital_equation: trainsets * trainset_price + direction_winding_m * winding_price_per_direction_m + concrete_m3 * concrete_installed_rate + steel_kg * steel_installed_rate + unpriced_station_terminal_depot_power_protection_pier_foundation_and_other_scope

energy.energy_scope: Mainline mechanical requirements under flat-route C+Qv² drag hypothesis; auxiliaries, converters, losses, terminal movement and faults are not closed

limitations: Accounted mass is a material subtotal; installed mass, CG, inertia, hardware and margins remain open.
The unpowered coast ODE uses declared drag and zero grade; no measured magnetic drag or levitated train trajectory is claimed.
Per-arrival station envelopes need compatible departure layouts, terminal designs, independent phase branches, grid/electrical/thermal sizing and surveyed sites.
Adjacent winding intervals may overlap. Motor isolation, handoff and physical sharing are unqualified; overlapping length is not free hardware.
Two-minute capacity is arithmetic; safe braking, availability, dwell, passenger control and receiving-power loss require independent qualification.
Prototype civil quantities are very heavy and unoptimised; reinforcement, foundations and complete installed costs remain unknown.

quantities.scope: Prototype section rate extrapolated over both retained mainline directions; not an optimised or installed civil design

service.terminal_timing: Retained context timing hypothesis only; terminal motion, motor length and energy remain open
